title: Native Ringed Restriction Localization
statement: Continuous and cocontinuous restriction of a commutative ring sheaf commutes with sheafified sectionwise localization at any compatible global section. The restricted section is its actual pullback along the site functor. Assume the displayed commutative-ring and additive sheafification structures on both sites; site and coefficient universes remain independent. Dependencies: [lem-pur-native-ringed-restriction-hom], [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization].

proof.text: sectionwise restriction of the localization presheaf is the localization presheaf of the restricted section: the rings, the sections and the universal localization lifts are identical. Apply the sheafification restriction comparison.

theorem localizationRestriction [F.IsCocontinuous K J]
    [HasSheafify J CommRingCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [HasSheafify K CommRingCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [HasSheafify K AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    [K.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c d vc vd r}]
    (s : (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    Nonempty ((restrictModules.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R).obj
      (ringedSectionLocalizationOfUniverses R s) ≅
        ringedSectionLocalizationOfUniverses
          (restrictedCommRing.{_, _, _, _, r} (K := K) F R)
          (restrictedSection.{_, _, _, _, r} F R s))
